Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starlite — next steps: technical workflow deep-dive

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — really helpful to understand the Starlite inference requirements (low-latency user-facing, multi-region rollout, and compliance constraints).

I propose we run a 60–75 minute technical workflow session focused on:
- End-to-end inference flow (serving runtime, KV cache, batching)
- Deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private VPC)
- Performance targets and an initial cost/throughput estimate
- Compatibility checks for your quantized model artifacts and networking requirements

Suggested dates/times (PST):
- Wed Jun 2, 10:00–11:15 AM
- Thu Jun 3, 2:00–3:15 PM
- Mon Jun 7, 9:00–10:15 AM

I've attached a short draft agenda and a lightweight checklist we typically run before a deep-dive.

If any of the times work, we'll loop in our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) and add a brief pre-call if you prefer to surface any infra constraints.

Cheers —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-starlite-deepdive-agenda.pdf

Hi Ben,

Thanks — the scope looks good. We can do Thu Jun 3, 2:00–3:15 PM PST. Can you also include Priya (our infra lead) and our SRE, and make sure we cover network egress and any required peering? We'd like a quick throughput/latency projection for a 2M daily active users (approx CPU/GPU footprint) and a short look at quantization tradeoffs.

Also, could you send the calendar invite? We'll need a dial-in link and the diagram attachments you mentioned.

Best,
